dublin_core_group.description: A special collection of aggregated columns from the 2021 5-year ACS variables at the census tract level selected for use with the Florida Stroke Registry. Please see the column metadata for the description of the columns.
dublin_core_group.provenance: direct from source and aggregated according to custom specification, see ETL documentation

iso_group.process_step:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/fl_2021_acs_5yr_tract_fsr/download -p /data/fl_2021_acs_5yr_tract_fsr/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/fl_2021_acs_5yr_tract_fsr
cd /data/fl_2021_acs_5yr_tract_fsr

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download specific variables from the census API, reformat census json to csv,
# and load as individual tables into postGIS with ogr2ogr.
if do_update = 1 then
  wget -O download/total_population.json" https://api.census.gov/data/2021/acs/acs5?get=B01001_001E&key=%24CENSUS_API_KEY&for=tract%3A%2A&in=state%3A12"

/g" | awk '!/null/' | 
  ogr2ogr -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres_connection>" csv:/vsistdin/ -nln total_population
